name: micromanager
families: research microscopes from Nikon, Zeiss, Olympus and Leica
scientific cameras from Hamamatsu, Andor, Photometrics and PCO
stages, focus drives, filter wheels, shutters and light sources from ASI, Prior, Ludl, Sutter, Lumencor and CoolLED
tests: the real pymmcore-plus core (UniMMCore) with a simulated camera, stages, turret, filter wheel, shutter and LED imaging a real micrograph

estimate.devices: about 250 device adapters, covering hundreds of microscope components
estimate.reasoning: Micro-Manager is the standard open source control layer for research microscopes, and its device support page lists about 250 adapters for cameras, stands, stages, focus drives, wheels, shutters, light sources and autofocus units. The driver reaches any of them a Micro-Manager configuration file loads. The count of adapters is read from that page, and the number of models each adapter covers varies.
